title: Where I have shipped real things.

items.overview: Led end-to-end development of a centralized medical event platform that scaled to 1,000+ daily active users during peak event periods.
responsibilities: Rebuilt 20+ legacy HTML/PHP pages as a React and Next.js SPA, introducing reusable UI components across five product modules, cutting page load time by 40%, and improving maintainability.
Reduced redundant API calls and improved rendering speed with TanStack Query, lazy loading, and memoized Chart.js dashboard computations, cutting response time by 30%.

Built C# and .NET REST APIs with a mapping and transformation layer that unified attendee data from residency, hospital, and admin systems; cached the unified output in Redis to avoid rebuilding it on every request.
Migrated legacy SQL queries to Entity Framework Core, reducing query-related bugs by 20% and improving maintainability and scalability.
Deployed on AWS using EC2, PostgreSQL on RDS, S3 for event document uploads, and Lambda for upload processing.
Improved production reliability and release speed with Jest tests, peer reviews, CloudWatch monitoring, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Docker, cutting production bugs by 25%.
Used Claude Code and custom AI workflows to improve code quality and debugging, cutting feature turnaround time from two weeks to four days.

items.overview: Rebuilt a legacy healthcare platform across two brands as the sole developer, supporting personalized mentor recommendations, wellness plan purchases, and community initiatives.
responsibilities: Rebuilt a legacy healthcare platform in three months as the sole developer using React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and PostgreSQL across two brands.
Integrated Stripe webhooks for purchase and subscription events, keeping payment status reliably synchronized between Stripe and the platform.
Raised Lighthouse scores from 40 to 80 and reduced load times by 70% through lazy loading, image optimization, and caching.
Used Google Analytics insights to guide SEO improvements across health articles and campaign pages.
Built a 10+ component design system with reusable components and standardized design tokens across two brands.
Built secure REST APIs with pagination, caching, SQL optimization, and rate limiting.
Integrated Sentry, achieved 80% Jest coverage, and set up Netlify CI/CD to improve reliability and release speed.

items.overview: Worked across two teams as an early Oracle VBS specialist, translating Berkshire Hathaway Energy stakeholder needs into reusable product components, integrations, and production solutions.
responsibilities: Became an early Oracle VBS specialist by mastering a newly launched platform with limited documentation and contributing across two teams.
Worked directly with Berkshire Hathaway Energy stakeholders to gather requirements and build CX and HCM workflows.
Delivered 20+ reusable Oracle VBS components with documented usage patterns, adopted across 4+ modules by teams of 10–20 developers, QA engineers, and consultants.
Designed workarounds for undocumented requirements and published reusable knowledge articles for other teams.
Architected an OCI-hosted REST middleware that synchronized BHE systems with Oracle Fusion Cloud across 10+ integrations.
Resolved 100+ production issues across frontend, middleware, and API layers during Agile cycles.
